scope: Assertions against captured interaction results, not a replay or physical-device test
checks: HID reorder and hide persisted in compact profile
Saving a new profile preserved the original
Actual slider releases saved opacity, radius, and spacing endpoints
Focus update deferred while the actual editor was open
Closing editor applied deferred Focus without modifying saved data
Confirmed deletion removed linked profile and dangling Focus link
HID scroll in short AX-largest viewport reached the final control without native-pan takeover
Real tap on final shortcut restored native fixture and requested DisplayModule
Real iOS 17.5 app probe reported service unavailable, not simulated success
